name: paper_validation_prep_80pct
comment: Full CC-CV charge (0.5C to 4.2V), rest 30 min, then a TIME-LIMITED 0.2C discharge capped at exactly 3600s (1h) -- removes ~20% of nominal capacity (0.2C x 1h = 0.2 x capacity), landing at ~80% SOC. v_min is set low (2.5V) specifically so this phase stops via the 1-hour time limit, not a voltage cutoff -- 2.5V should not be reachable from 100% SOC at 0.2C within an hour. Rest 30 min after. Then run 04b_validation_profile.json (which assumes it's starting from this ~80% SOC state -- run these two files back-to-back, don't let the cell rest for days between them or self-discharge will drift the actual SOC).
